cancelReservation(address,uint256,uint25.notice: Rollback: cancel reservation, keep original owner.

deposit(address,uint256).notice: Deposit an NFT into the vault. Caller must have approved NFTVault.

finalizeForSettlement(address,uint256,ad.notice: Finalize: change logical owner, keep NFT in vault.

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.notice: Allow this contract to receive ERC-721 via safeTransferFrom
